winter school. For students of all faculties and any background a systematic introduction is given in a single introductory seminar on mathematical aspects of (N)-coloring problems. This course is free for students of all Faculties.
Problem: Given an input of a 3-coloring of a simple 4-cell complex, it is asked how can a triangulation of a minimal surface area be produced which is N-colord in such a way that all vertices of are all of the same colour (same color). Can one find a triangulation with only one possible colour assignment?
For a detailed description of N-coloring problems and how to study them from a pure mathematics perspective see e.g.: "N-coloring" by G. Rote (2016), available at https://arxiv.org/pdf/1511.09214.pdf
Prerequisities
Knowledge in Mathematical Computation (MathComp).
